payout_quote: While collecting a deposit is not required in statute, consumers are entitled to receive a 10-cent refund when they return redeemable containers to stores or redemption centers.
steps: Buy beverages in redeemable containers in Oregon (10¢ deposit commonly charged at checkout)
Save empties and open a free BottleDrop account / get Green Bags, or hand-count under 50 at a center
Drop Green Bags at a BottleDrop redemption center or use in-store reverse vending machines
Receive the 10¢-per-container refund as cash, account credit, or voucher
catches: This returns YOUR OWN deposit money paid at purchase — it is recovering your own money, not new income.
Only containers bought in-state with the correct deposit label are redeemable; out-of-state containers are ineligible and redeeming them is fraud.
BottleDrop Green Bag account funds can be withdrawn as cash at kiosks; large retailers must accept at least 144 containers per person per day (50 for small stores).
biggest_catch: Returns your own 10¢ deposit — you paid it at purchase. This is deposit recovery, not income.
eligibility: Anyone returning redeemable containers purchased in Oregon; free BottleDrop account optional for Green Bags.
timing: Refund paid at return (cash/voucher) or credited to BottleDrop account.

c1.evidence: Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission (OLCC) administers the Bottle Bill by statute; guidelines on oregon.gov.

c2.evidence: Official OLCC retailer guidelines: consumers are entitled to receive a 10-cent refund per returned redeemable container.

c3.evidence: No fee; free BottleDrop account and Green Bags.

c4.evidence: 10¢ per container refund; paid at stores/redemption centers; BottleDrop centers staffed 7 days, min 9 hrs/day.

s2.note: Cash or account-credit refund per container.

s3.note: Paid at return; Green Bag credits available within ~24h.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: buy, save, drop at BottleDrop/store, get refund.

notes: Oregon pioneered the bottle bill (1971); OBRC operates the BottleDrop network.
numeric_basis: payout from official OLCC terms (10¢/container); time: bagging/tagging + drop-off trip est. 20–60 min active.
